title: The Magic of the Moon
content:
Long ago, in a small kingdom, there was a young wizard named Leo.

In the month of October, strange things began to happen in the kingdom.

Every night, at midnight, a mysterious blue light appeared above the Dark Forest.

The king was worried.

On Monday, he called Leo to the castle.

“You must discover the secret of the blue light,” the king said.

Leo began his journey in the morning.

He walked through the forest for many hours.

At noon, he stopped near a river to rest.

Suddenly, an old woman appeared.

“You are too late,” she whispered.

“Too late for what?” Leo asked.

“The magic will disappear at midnight.”

Leo quickly continued his journey.

In the afternoon, he found an ancient tower hidden between the trees.

On the door, there was a message:

“Come back on the night of the full moon.”

Leo looked at the sky.

Fortunately, the full moon was coming on Friday.

For the next few days, Leo prepared for the magical night.

Finally, on Friday evening, he returned to the tower.

At eleven o'clock, the blue light appeared again.

Leo entered the tower and climbed to the top.

Then, exactly at midnight, he discovered the truth.

The blue light was coming from a magical crystal.

The crystal protected the entire kingdom.

But it only worked at night and disappeared in the morning.

Leo understood the old woman's warning.

The magic wasn't disappearing forever.

It was simply waiting for the right time.

From that day on, the people of the kingdom watched the blue light every full moon.

And at midnight, they remembered the young wizard who discovered the secret hidden in time.
